$comment: The findings whose reason code changed in a minor release while the finding stayed the same (a rule that gave none now gives one, or a code split by cause): a baseline entry written under the old code still matches the finding under the new one, with the same rule, markup and frame (src/baseline.js, docs/BASELINE.md "Upgrading"). `since` is the minor release the finding moved in; `stillGiven` marks a split, whose old code the rule still gives for other findings. scripts/freeze-finding-ids.js drops a move at the release after the one it shipped in, so a move applies to baselines from the one minor release before it.
